key_idea: Process animals from strongest to weakest: the current stable group attacks, and everyone below it (who would be eliminated in turn if the weakest falls) defends; a new stable group forms as soon as the pending animals' strength sum reaches the stable group's sum.
sketch: Sort descending. Keep att = strength sum of the current stable top group and def = sum of the animals examined since. An animal in the pending block knows that if the weakest goes, the chain continues down to the stable group, so it defends; stable members attack since they are safe. When def >= att (attack must be strictly greater to succeed) the whole prefix becomes stable: att += def, def = 0, record its size. The answer is the last recorded size. O(n log n), sums need 64-bit (up to 5e14).
